subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `sessionClosedAt` as a persisted, cross-channel session lifecycle marker for externally closed threads?
rationale: This changes the durable session contract and the conditions that archive or replace user transcripts; tests establish behavior but cannot choose the permanent ownership and upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve a narrow durable marker
options.body: Keep the marker as the canonical rollover signal, after removing unrelated edits and proving the rebased lifecycle paths.

options.title: Use an owner-specific alternative
options.body: Keep Discord closure state within the Discord owner boundary if maintainers do not want a generic persisted session field.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow durable marker
recommendation.body: Keep the marker as the canonical rollover signal, after removing unrelated edits and proving the rebased lifecycle paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the proposed lifecycle contract; current-main area ownership needs maintainer confirmation.
